data.narrative:
Solid Power is a public-stage Climate & Energy company founded by Doug Campbell that has raised $232M to date and carries a current valuation of $504M. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 3 same-sector, same-stage companies: QuantumScape ($3.6B), Enovix ($1.0B), and LanzaTech ($73M), reflecting the wide dispersion typical of early-stage energy technology.

The peer-median method is the applicable triangulation approach here. The median valuation across the three public comparables stands at $1.0B, with a range spanning $73M to $3.6B. This method implies a fair value of $1.0B for Solid Power, substantially above its current $504M mark. The wide spread among peers—driven by differences in technology maturity, capital intensity, and market readiness—indicates material uncertainty in positioning within the cohort.

The triangulated valuation range of $850M to $1.1B (median $1.0B) reflects a single-method analysis, which constrains confidence in the estimate. The current $504M valuation implies an implied upside to the median of approximately 98%, though the peer range suggests valuations could reasonably extend either direction. Key uncertainties include commercialization timeline, manufacturing scale risk, and relative technological differentiation versus QuantumScape and Enovix. The thinness of the comparable set (one method, three peers) argues for caution in treating any point estimate as definitive.
